branding.subtitle: Comprehensive Project Requirements & System Specification

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content:
The TekQuora Corporate Website & Content Management System (CMS) is a modern web application designed to establish a strong digital presence for TekQuora while providing a secure and scalable platform for managing website content. The system combines a professional public-facing corporate website with a custom-built administrative Content Management System (CMS), enabling administrators to manage website content dynamically without requiring any modifications to the application's source code.

The website functions as the official online platform for TekQuora, showcasing the company's services, expertise, completed projects, technical capabilities, work culture, leadership team, and contact information. It serves as both a marketing platform and a lead generation system by allowing prospective clients to submit project inquiries directly through an integrated contact form.

The administrative portal enables authorized users to efficiently manage every section of the website, including homepage banners, company information, services, portfolio projects, team members, image galleries, client inquiries, SEO settings, and system configuration.

The department held a meeting to discuss progress on the upcoming annual college technology symposium, which will bring together students, faculty members, industry professionals, and representatives from several technology organizations. sections.title: Platform Overview and Objectives
sections.content:
C2Talents is a full-stack, AI-assisted higher-education discovery and admission platform designed to centralize college search, institutional evaluation, and application processes for Indian students. Operating on a student-first model supported by a dynamic Admin CMS, the platform replaces fragmented search across multiple websites with a unified, data-driven system.

  • Centralizes college search, academic stream exploration, and course discovery into a single platform.
  • Provides comprehensive decision tools including side-by-side college comparison, cutoff analysis, financial aid exploration, and placement tracking.
  • Features a dynamic database architecture allowing administrators to update content without modifying frontend code.

sections.title: Technical Architecture and Technology Stack
sections.content:
C2Talents is built as a unified Next.js application using TypeScript across both frontend and backend layers. Frontend components handle public student interactions and administrative CMS interfaces, while backend functionality manages data logic, security, and integration services without requiring a separate server framework.

  • Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS powering a responsive, component-based user interface.
  • Backend: Next.js App Router and TypeScript Route Handlers managing business logic, API endpoints, authentication, and email services.
  • Database Layer: Prisma ORM managing structured relational data, pre-populated with an imported dataset of 245 colleges and 4,129 courses.
  • Authentication: JWT-based authentication using HTTP-only cookies, password hashing with bcrypt, and server-side role-based access control.
  • AI Processing: Integrated Google Gemini 2.5 Flash for automated college data extraction and intelligent student guidance.

sections.title: Student Discovery and Experience Features
sections.content:
The student-facing platform provides clean navigation, high-quality visual identity, and comprehensive research tools to guide students from initial discovery through institution selection.

  • Multi-Parametric Discovery: Search colleges by name, location, stream, ranking, ratings, and course offerings.
  • Asset Management: Displays official college logos using original aspect ratios alongside separate dynamically managed banner images.
  • Institutional Comparison: Visual side-by-side comparison tool covering NIRF rankings, NAAC accreditation, placement packages, and fee structures.
  • Stream and Destination Hubs: Animated discovery sections organized by academic streams (Engineering, Management, Medical, Law) and major Indian educational cities.
  • Exam Corner and Cutoff Predictor: Information hubs for major entrance exams (JEE Main, TNEA, NEET UG, CAT) featuring historical cutoff trends and official authority verification links.
  • Scholarship Directory: Searchable catalog of verified government, private, merit-based, and category-specific financial aid schemes.
  • Ask AI Counselor: Conversational AI assistant supporting stream exploration, decision-making, and academic guidance.

sections.title: Application Workflow and Dynamic Lead Generation
sections.content:
C2Talents provides a dynamic, end-to-end application system that guides registered students through institutional application submissions while delivering verified leads to administrators.

  • Student Registration: Requires user authentication before application initiation to link submissions with student profiles.
  • Contextual Course Filtering: Application forms dynamically fetch and display only the courses offered by the specifically selected college.
  • Adaptive Data Collection: Form fields dynamically adapt based on qualification level, gathering school records, undergraduate details for PG applicants, and uploaded marksheets.
  • Lead Management: Submitted applications transfer to the Admin CMS for operational review across statuses such as Submitted, Under Review, Contacted, Approved, Rejected, and Completed.
  • Application Tracker: Real-time portal enabling students to monitor the status of their submitted applications.

sections.title: Dynamic Email System and Communication Management
sections.content:
The platform includes an enterprise-grade dynamic email engine that automates corporate-style communications for user onboarding, account events, and college publishing workflows.

  • CMS Template Manager: In-system editor allowing administrators to dynamically alter email subject lines, body copy, CTA buttons, and styling.
  • Dynamic Placeholders: Supports template variables such as college names, contact persons, and portal links that automatically populate upon sending.
  • Drafting and Audit Control: Features live template previews, version management, draft saving, and audit logs before publishing updates.
  • Configurable SMTP Engine: Native SMTP setup supporting custom hosts, ports, credentials, and real-time delivery testing.

sections.title: Administrative CMS and Platform Controls
sections.content:
The C2Talents Admin CMS acts as the central control center for platform data, institutional onboarding, SEO optimization, and platform analytics.

  • AI-Assisted Data Extraction: Enter a college website URL to automatically extract structured data and populate comprehensive profiles for review.
  • Institutional Onboarding: Manage college registration requests, profile approvals, and automated institutional notifications.
  • Content & Image Control: Dynamic Header Image Manager for controlling hero assets alongside CMS sections for educational news and alerts.
  • Analytics & Data Integrity: Central dashboard tracking application counts, lead activity, and search metrics while strictly enforcing factual data quality standards.

sections.title: Project Overview
sections.content:
C2Talents is a full-stack, AI-assisted higher-education discovery and admission platform designed to help Indian students find, compare, evaluate, and apply to colleges and courses from a single platform.

The core idea of C2Talents is to bring together the major activities a student normally performs across multiple education websites into one centralized system. Students can search for colleges, explore academic streams, view college information, compare institutions, check entrance-exam information and cutoffs, explore scholarships, review placement information, and submit applications.

The platform is designed around a student-first experience, while a powerful Admin CMS manages the underlying college, course, application, content, email, and platform data dynamically.

The project is not intended to be a static college-information website. The architecture is designed so that most important information is stored in the database and rendered dynamically on the frontend. Administrators can update information through the CMS without modifying frontend code.

sections.title: Main Objective
sections.content:
The primary objective of C2Talents is to empower Indian students to discover the right college and course, understand admission opportunities, compare institutions, access financial-aid information, and submit applications through a single data-driven platform.

The platform focuses on:

  • College discovery
  • Course discovery
  • College comparison
  • Admission guidance
  • Application/lead generation
  • Scholarships
  • Entrance examinations
  • Cutoff information
  • Placement information
  • College profiles
  • Student accounts
  • Dynamic content management
  • AI-assisted college data collection
  • Automated institutional communication
  • Admin-controlled email templates
  • Dynamic website content

sections.title: Overall System Architecture
sections.content:
C2Talents follows a full-stack architecture where the same Next.js application handles both the frontend and backend.

The high-level architecture links Student Website and Admin CMS through a Next.js application, separated into React/TSX Frontend and Route Handlers Backend with Business Logic and Prisma ORM connecting to the Database.

The project uses Next.js with TypeScript for the application layer.

Next.js is responsible for both:

  • Frontend UI
  • Backend API functionality

The backend uses Next.js Route Handlers such as route.ts.

Prisma is used as the ORM/database access layer.

sections.title: Frontend
sections.content:
• Next.js
  • React
  • TypeScript
  • HTML
  • CSS
  • Tailwind CSS
  • Responsive UI
  • Modern component-based architecture

The frontend provides the public student-facing website and the administrative CMS interface.

sections.title: Backend
sections.content:
The backend is implemented inside the Next.js application.

Backend technologies:

  • Next.js App Router
  • Next.js Route Handlers
  • TypeScript
  • Server-side business logic
  • API endpoints
  • Authentication
  • Database operations
  • Email services
  • AI processing

There is no requirement for a separate Express.js backend in the current architecture.

sections.title: Database Layer
sections.content:
The project uses Prisma ORM for database communication.

The current development configuration uses a Prisma-managed database, with the project context also containing imported MySQL college/course data.

The important architectural principle is that frontend components should not directly manage database logic. Database access is handled through the backend and Prisma.

sections.title: Authentication
sections.content:
The application uses authentication mechanisms including:

  • JWT-based authentication
  • HTTP-only cookies
  • Password hashing using bcrypt
  • Role-based access concepts

The Admin CMS is intended to be protected so that unauthorized users cannot access administrative functionality.

The public website and the Admin CMS are treated as separate access experiences.

sections.title: Public Student Website
sections.content:
The public website is the primary interface for students.

The website provides a modern education-platform design using the C2Talents visual identity.

The main navigation includes areas such as:

  • Home
  • Colleges
  • Explore Streams
  • Scholarships
  • Exam Corner
  • Application Tracker
  • Ask AI Counselor
  • Register College

The website also contains a college registration option for institutions.

sections.title: Home Page
sections.content:
The homepage acts as the primary discovery interface.

The hero section contains dynamic background/banner images, main education-focused headline, college search, course search, city search, quick category links, college discovery functionality, and AI-assisted guidance.

The hero background images are intended to be managed dynamically rather than permanently hardcoded.

The Admin CMS includes a Header Images section where administrators can add high-quality images and assign their display position.

This allows the homepage hero/banner images to be changed without modifying application code.

sections.title: Dynamic Header Image Management
sections.content:
A dedicated Header Images menu exists inside the Admin CMS.

Administrators can:

  • Upload/add header images
  • Manage multiple images
  • Assign image positions
  • Control which image appears in which position
  • Update images dynamically

The system is designed to support high-quality images.

The frontend retrieves these images dynamically from the database rather than using hardcoded image paths.

The header/banner implementation also requires careful image rendering so that important parts of an image are not unnecessarily cropped.

The intended visual result is a professional, high-quality education-platform hero section with enhanced, colorful background photography.

sections.title: College Discovery
sections.content:
The college discovery system is one of the core features of C2Talents.

Students can search for colleges using college name, location, city, course, academic stream, and other relevant filters.

The college listing displays information such as college name, location, ranking, placement information, rating, apply option, compare option, and college logo.

A key requirement is that the listing should use the official college logo, not a random campus photograph.

The data model should therefore distinguish between logoUrl and imageUrl / bannerImageUrl.

The logo should preserve its original aspect ratio and be displayed using a clean object-fit: contain presentation.

sections.title: College Database
sections.content:
The project has a large college dataset. An imported dataset contains approximately 245 colleges and 4,129 courses.

The imported dataset includes college and course information.

Important college fields include:

  • College ID
  • College name
  • College category
  • Location
  • Normalized location
  • Website
  • Email
  • Phone
  • NAAC grade
  • Principal name
  • Autonomous status
  • NIRF rank
  • University category
  • Hostel availability
  • Google rating
  • Latitude
  • Longitude
  • Placement score
  • Co-education status
  • UGC recognition
  • Ownership

The C2Talents CMS also extends the college information model with additional fields covering SEO, gallery, AI-generated descriptions, facilities, admissions, fees, hostel, placements, scholarships, and education loans.

The goal is to provide students with a detailed college profile rather than only basic contact information.

sections.title: AI College Data Collection
sections.content:
One of the important C2Talents features is AI-assisted college data collection.

An administrator can provide a college website URL. The system can use AI to extract relevant information from the college website and populate the college record.

The intended flow is: Admin enters College Website URL -> AI/Data Extraction -> College Information Processing -> Structured College Data -> Admin Review -> Save College -> Database -> Public College Profile.

The system is designed to avoid manually hardcoding college information into frontend components.

Once saved, the college information becomes available dynamically to the public website.

sections.title: College Profile
sections.content:
Each college has a dedicated profile page.

The profile can contain:

  • College name
  • Location
  • Contact information
  • Website
  • Accreditation
  • NIRF information
  • About college
  • History
  • Key highlights
  • Why choose the college
  • Campus life
  • Facilities
  • Placements
  • Top recruiters
  • Admission guide
  • Eligibility
  • Hostel
  • Scholarships
  • Research and innovation
  • Student activities
  • FAQ
  • SEO content

The profile is designed to provide students with a complete overview before they decide whether to apply.

sections.title: College Courses
sections.content:
Courses are connected to colleges dynamically.

This is particularly important for the application system. If a student selects a particular college, the application form should display only the courses available at that selected college.

Courses must not be globally displayed without considering the selected institution.

sections.title: College Comparison
sections.content:
C2Talents includes an institutional comparison feature. Students can select multiple colleges and compare them.

The comparison experience can consider:

  • Ranking
  • Accreditation
  • Courses
  • Placement
  • Highest package
  • Average package
  • Rating
  • Location
  • Other institutional information

The UI is designed to provide a clear side-by-side comparison.

The platform also contains a visual Institutional Comparison section featuring comparison criteria such as NIRF, NAAC, CTC/placement information, package insights, and side-by-side comparison.

The comparison experience should remain professional and easy to understand for students.

sections.title: Study Streams / Study Goals
sections.content:
C2Talents includes a Study Goal or academic-stream discovery section.

Students can explore areas such as:

  • Engineering
  • Medical
  • Arts & Science
  • MBA / Management
  • Law
  • Other academic streams

Each stream can display number of colleges, popular degrees, stream-specific information, and relevant institutions.

The section is designed to help students begin their college search from their intended academic field.

The UI includes animated interactions and modern visual cards.

sections.title: Top Study Destinations
sections.content:
The platform contains a Top Study Destinations section to help students explore colleges based on location.

Example destinations include:

  • Chennai
  • Coimbatore
  • Vellore
  • Bangalore
  • Trichy
  • Madurai

The destination cards display the number of colleges available in each location.

The section is intended to be interactive and visually engaging.

sections.title: Entrance Exam / Exam Corner
sections.content:
C2Talents includes an Exam Corner to provide students with information about major entrance examinations and admission-related timelines.

The exam section can contain:

  • Exam name
  • Examination description
  • Registration information
  • Important dates
  • Results
  • Cutoff information
  • Participating colleges
  • Official website links

Examples of major exams represented in the interface include JEE Main, TNEA, NEET UG, and CAT.

The system should distinguish between official information and historical/indicative information.

For student safety, cutoff information should clearly indicate when values are estimates or historical and should encourage verification against official authorities.

sections.title: Cutoff Information
sections.content:
The platform contains a Cutoffs & Exam Predictor section intended to help students understand previous cutoff trends and potential admission opportunities.

The interface can display:

  • Exam
  • Category
  • Cutoff
  • Participating colleges
  • Admission/counselling status
  • Official authority link

The system must avoid presenting estimated cutoff numbers as guaranteed admission results.

The platform should clearly communicate that historical cutoff information is for reference and should be verified with official authorities.

sections.title: Scholarship Directory
sections.content:
C2Talents also contains a Scholarships Directory to help students discover financial-aid opportunities.

Scholarship information can include:

  • Scholarship name
  • Provider
  • Government/private classification
  • Eligibility
  • Course/degree
  • Category
  • State
  • Deadline
  • Official application portal
  • Scholarship type

The interface contains filtering options such as:

  • All
  • Government
  • Private
  • Merit-based
  • Need-based
  • Girl students
  • SC/ST
  • BC/MBC
  • Minority
  • Course/degree
  • Deadline status

The scholarship data should be based on genuine, verifiable schemes rather than placeholder content because students may use this information for actual financial decisions.

sections.title: Student Registration and Authentication
sections.content:
A student must have an account before submitting a college application.

The intended flow is: Student visits College -> Clicks Apply -> Login / Register -> Student Account -> Application Form -> Submit Application.

The registration/login process allows the platform to associate applications with the correct student.

The student can subsequently use the application tracker to monitor application-related information.

sections.title: Student Application / Lead Generation
sections.content:
The application system is a major business feature of C2Talents. When a student visits a college profile and decides to apply, the student should be guided into a structured application process.

The application flow is: Student selects College -> Student clicks Apply -> Login / Register -> Application Form -> Personal Details -> Academic Details -> Course Selection -> Marks / Qualification Details -> Upload Marksheet -> Review -> Submit -> Application Success -> Admin Lead.

The application form should dynamically adapt to the student's selected education level.

For example, if the student is applying for a postgraduate course, the system can additionally request relevant undergraduate college information.

sections.title: Dynamic Course Selection in Application
sections.content:
A critical requirement is that only courses offered by the selected college should appear in the application form.

The form should dynamically query the selected college's course list and should never display unrelated courses from other colleges.

Example: For PSG College of Technology, only available courses such as B.E. Computer Science and Engineering, B.E. Electronics and Communication Engineering, and B.E. Mechanical Engineering should be available for selection.

sections.title: Academic Information
sections.content:
The student application can collect academic information such as:

  • School details
  • Board
  • Year of completion
  • Marks/percentage
  • Academic qualification
  • Undergraduate college for postgraduate applicants
  • Undergraduate qualification details
  • Relevant marks

The form should dynamically ask additional information based on the student's selected application type.

sections.title: Marksheet Upload
sections.content:
The application process includes document upload where students can upload their marksheet or relevant academic document.

The system should associate the uploaded document with the student's application.

The document becomes available to authorized administrators for application review.

sections.title: Application Submission Confirmation
sections.content:
After successfully completing the application, the student should receive a professional confirmation message.

The intended message is: Your application has been submitted successfully. Our admissions team will review your details and contact you regarding the next steps.

The confirmation should be professional and reassuring without implying guaranteed admission.

sections.title: Admin Leads
sections.content:
All submitted student applications become available inside the Admin CMS under a Leads or equivalent application-management area.

Administrators should be able to view the submitted information.

Lead information can include:

  • Student name
  • Email
  • Phone
  • Selected college
  • Selected course
  • Academic details
  • Application date
  • Uploaded documents
  • Application status
  • Review status
  • Contact information

The purpose is to give the administrative team a centralized view of potential student applicants.

sections.title: Application Status
sections.content:
The application workflow can support statuses such as:

  • Submitted
  • Under Review
  • Contacted
  • Approved
  • Rejected
  • Completed

The status can be managed by authorized administrators.

Students can use the Application Tracker to view relevant application progress.

sections.title: Admin CMS
sections.content:
The C2Talents Admin CMS is the control center for managing the platform.

The Admin Portal contains areas such as:

  • Dashboard
  • Registration Requests
  • Submitted Colleges
  • All Colleges
  • Header Images
  • Add College AI
  • Categories
  • Courses
  • News & Alerts
  • Users & Leads
  • Analytics
  • Email Templates
  • SMTP Settings

The CMS is designed to keep the public website dynamically connected to administrative data.

sections.title: College Registration Requests
sections.content:
Colleges can submit registration requests to C2Talents.

The Admin CMS provides a Registration Requests section where administrators can review these requests.

The interface can display college name, location, contact person, email, phone, website, request status, notes, and actions.

Possible statuses include:

  • Pending
  • Approved
  • Rejected
  • Published

Administrators can approve or reject requests. Once a college is approved/published, the corresponding workflow can trigger an automated institutional email.

sections.title: College Publishing Workflow
sections.content:
The intended workflow is: College Registration Request -> Admin Review -> Approve -> College Data Submitted -> Admin Review -> Publish -> College Appears Publicly -> Professional Email Sent to College.

The publishing process is therefore connected to the communication system.

sections.title: Professional Email System
sections.content:
C2Talents contains a dynamic email system.

The platform sends emails to colleges and users for events such as:

  • Registration request received
  • Registration approved
  • Registration rejected
  • Profile submission
  • Profile published
  • Password reset
  • Account/team invitation
  • Welcome email
  • Other platform notifications

A strict requirement is that emails sent from C2Talents must look like professional corporate emails.

They should not contain:

  • Childish emojis
  • Casual language
  • Excessive decorative elements
  • Unprofessional wording

The emails should resemble official communications from established companies.

sections.title: Dynamic Email Template Manager
sections.content:
The Admin CMS contains an Email Template Manager to allow administrators to control the exact format of platform emails.

The system should not simply show a generic email preview; instead, the actual email templates used by the platform should be editable from the Admin CMS.

Administrators should be able to modify:

  • Email subject
  • Preheader
  • Header title
  • Greeting
  • Body content
  • CTA button
  • CTA URL/variable
  • Footer
  • Support information
  • Styling/HTML

The email preview should represent the actual email that the system will send.

sections.title: Dynamic Email Template Workflow
sections.content:
The intended workflow is: Admin opens Email Template Manager -> Selects email type -> Edits subject/content/style -> Preview updates -> Admin clicks Save -> Template stored in database -> Future emails use saved template.

The important requirement is that once an administrator changes and saves a template, future emails of that type must use the updated version.

Email formatting should not remain hardcoded in source code.

sections.title: Dynamic Variables in Emails
sections.content:
Email templates support dynamic variables such as {{collegeName}}, {{contactPerson}}, {{portalLink}}, {{supportEmail}}, {{companyName}}, and {{currentYear}}.

These variables are replaced with actual values when the email is sent.

This makes the email system reusable across multiple colleges and events.

sections.title: Governance and Next Meeting
sections.content:
Communication guidelines were reinforced to ensure smooth coordination across all teams leading up to the symposium.

  • Communication Protocol: Team leaders must provide progress updates every two days via the committee group, report delays immediately, and consult the faculty coordinator before finalizing major schedule, budget, speaker, or venue changes.
  • Next Meeting: Scheduled for Friday afternoon to review the registration system, speaker confirmations, volunteer list, promotional materials, venue report, budget plans, and event website progress.

sections.title: About TekQuora
sections.content:
TekQuora is a technology-driven software development company dedicated to delivering innovative digital solutions that help businesses accelerate their digital transformation. The company specializes in designing and developing high-quality web applications, enterprise software solutions, mobile applications, cloud-based systems, artificial intelligence solutions, and user-centric digital experiences.

TekQuora's primary objective is to provide reliable, scalable, and performance-oriented software solutions that solve real-world business challenges. By combining technical expertise with modern development methodologies, the company delivers software products that improve operational efficiency, enhance customer engagement, and support long-term business growth.

sections.title: Business Background
sections.content:
In today's competitive digital environment, businesses require a strong online presence to establish credibility, communicate their expertise, and attract potential customers. Before the development of this system, TekQuora lacked a centralized and easily manageable platform for presenting its services and updating website content efficiently.

Content modifications required direct changes to application source code, making updates time-consuming and dependent on software developers. This process increased maintenance costs and delayed content publishing. To overcome these challenges, TekQuora initiated the development of a custom Content Management System integrated with a responsive corporate website.

sections.title: Project Vision
sections.content: To establish TekQuora as a trusted technology partner by delivering a modern, secure, scalable, and user-friendly corporate website integrated with a powerful Content Management System that enhances customer engagement, strengthens the company's digital presence, and simplifies website administration.

sections.title: Project Mission
sections.content:
The mission of the TekQuora Corporate Website & CMS is to provide a professional digital platform that enables businesses and clients to understand TekQuora's capabilities while empowering administrators to manage all website content through an intuitive, secure, and efficient administration interface.

The project focuses on delivering an exceptional user experience, maintaining high security standards, ensuring responsive design across devices, and supporting future scalability.

sections.title: Project Objectives
sections.content:
The primary objectives of the project are:

• Develop a modern and responsive corporate website representing TekQuora's brand identity.
• Design and implement a secure administrator dashboard for content management.
• Enable dynamic management of website content without modifying source code.
• Showcase company services, portfolio projects, work culture, and technical expertise.
• Provide a centralized platform for managing customer inquiries.
• Improve search engine visibility through configurable SEO settings.
• Deliver a scalable and maintainable application following MVC architecture.
• Ensure compatibility across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
• Implement secure authentication and authorization mechanisms.
• Reduce long-term website maintenance efforts through an integrated CMS.

sections.title: Business Need
sections.content:
The project addresses several key business challenges:

• Lack of centralized content management.
• Dependence on developers for routine website updates.
• Limited visibility of company services and portfolio.
• Absence of structured inquiry management.
• Inconsistent branding across website sections.
• Difficulty maintaining dynamic content.
• Need for improved customer engagement.
• Requirement for a scalable platform supporting future enhancements.

sections.title: Project Scope
sections.content:
In Scope:
The project includes the complete development of the following modules:

Public Website:
• Home Page & Interactive Hero Banner
• About Us Page & Corporate History
• Our Services Showcase
• Work Culture & Employee Value Proposition
• Team Members Directory
• Project Portfolio & Case Studies
• Contact Us Form with Interactive Maps
• Image & Moments Gallery
• Responsive Navigation Header & Global Footer Management

Administration Portal:
• Secure Role-Based Authentication & Dashboard Analytics
• Hero Banner Management & Header Management
• Services, Portfolio, Gallery, Team, and Inquiry Management Modules
• System SEO Configuration & Mail Service Settings

Out of Scope:
• Online Payment Gateway & E-Commerce Shopping Cart
• ERP Integration & Multi-language Localization

sections.title: Project Deliverables
sections.content:
The project delivers the following core deliverables:

1. Fully Responsive Corporate Website Application
2. Administrative Content Management System (CMS) Dashboard
3. SQLite / MySQL Relational Database Schema & Data Models
4. Contact Inquiry Management & Email Notification System
5. Comprehensive Technical & User Documentation Manuals

sections.title: Key Stakeholders
sections.content: The key project stakeholders and their respective responsibilities:

rows: Defines business requirements and approves deliverables
Oversees planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery
Designs the user interface and user experience
Develop frontend, backend, and CMS modules
Manages website content through the CMS
Browse website services, portfolio, and submit inquiries

sections.title: Success Criteria
sections.content:
The project will be considered successful when:

• All planned website pages are fully functional and responsive.
• The CMS enables administrators to update all website content without code changes.
• Customer inquiries are stored successfully and email notifications are dispatched.
• Responsive layouts function flawlessly across desktop, tablet, and mobile viewports.
• Authentication mechanisms effectively prevent unauthorized administrative access.

sections.title: Project Constraints
sections.content:
• Fixed project timeline and milestone delivery dates.
• Limited development resources and allocated budget.
• Browser compatibility requirements across major modern browsers.
• External SMTP dependency for email notifications.

sections.title: Project Assumptions
sections.content:
• All project requirements are approved before development phase.
• Hosting infrastructure supports Node / PHP environment.
• Client provides official branding assets, logos, and initial copy.

sections.title: TekQuora Administration Portal (Content Management System)
sections.content:
Introduction
The TekQuora Administration Portal is a secure and centralized Content Management System (CMS) developed to simplify the management of the TekQuora Corporate Website. Built using the Laravel Framework, the CMS enables authorized administrators to manage every aspect of the website through an intuitive web interface without modifying the application's source code.

The administration portal provides complete control over website content, including homepage banners, company information, services, portfolio projects, team members, work culture, gallery images, customer inquiries, footer content, and system configuration. By offering dedicated management modules, the CMS ensures that website content remains accurate, up-to-date, and consistent while significantly reducing maintenance effort.

The system is protected using Laravel's authentication and middleware mechanisms, ensuring that only authorized users can access administrative functions.

sections.title: Administrator Login
sections.content:
The administration portal is accessible only to authenticated users through a secure login page.

Login URL
http://127.0.0.1:8000/admin/login

Administrator Credentials:

sections.title: Administrator Dashboard
sections.content:
The Dashboard serves as the central management interface of the TekQuora CMS. It provides administrators with a real-time overview of website activities, project statistics, customer inquiries, and system status immediately after login.

The dashboard presents important information through interactive summary cards and quick-access panels, allowing administrators to efficiently monitor website performance and manage daily operations.

Dashboard Features
• Website overview and analytics
• Active projects count
• Open customer inquiries
• Resolved inquiry statistics
• Total leads captured
• Recent customer messages
• Website module status
• Quick navigation to management modules

The dashboard acts as the primary control centre from which administrators can access all other content management modules.

sections.title: Header Management
sections.content:
The Header Management module controls the website's branding and navigation menu. It enables administrators to modify the website header dynamically without editing source code.

Administrators can upload company logos, configure navigation menu labels, and update navigation links displayed across the website.

Managed Components
• Company Logo
• Navigation Menu
• Menu Labels
• Navigation Links
• Header Display Settings

Changes made within this module are immediately reflected throughout the website.

sections.title: About Page Management
sections.content:
The About Page Management module allows administrators to update company information presented on the About Us page.

• Vision Statement
• Mission Statement
• Core Values
• Timeline
• About Images

Maintaining this information through the CMS ensures that company details remain current and professionally presented.

sections.title: System Configuration
sections.content:

Configuration Options

• Meta Description
• SMTP Configuration
• Google Analytics
• Maintenance Mode

Centralized configuration simplifies administration while ensuring consistent system behaviour across all modules.

sections.title: Summary
sections.content: The TekQuora Corporate Website successfully combines a visually engaging corporate presence with a powerful Laravel-based Content Management System. It enables visitors to explore the company's services, projects, team, and work culture while providing administrators with a centralized platform to manage all website content dynamically. Through its responsive design, structured navigation, inquiry management system, and scalable architecture, the application delivers a professional digital experience that supports TekQuora's business objectives and strengthens its online presence.
